scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true}); for (const f of ['index.html','app.js','engine.mjs','styles.css','manifest.webmanifest','icon.svg','sw.js']) { if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error(f+' missing'); fs.copyFileSync(f,'dist/'+f); } console.log('Transformation Engine v4 deploy build complete: dist/');"
